title: Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: Australian Government (Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade)
description: Long-term development scholarships for citizens of partner countries across the Indo-Pacific and Africa to undertake full-time undergraduate or postgraduate study at participating Australian universities, with a commitment to return home for at least two years after study.
amount: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, contribution to living expenses, health cover

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by country, opens 1 February)

title: Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarships
description: Block-grant funding distributed by more than 40 Australian universities to support domestic and international students undertaking a Master's by Research or PhD. Each university runs its own rounds and selection.
amount: Tuition offset, annual living stipend (~AUD 37,000-38,500), health cover and allowances

title: Melbourne Research Scholarship
description: Competitive scholarship for high-achieving domestic and international students commencing a graduate research degree (PhD or Master's by Research) at the University of Melbourne. Most applicants are considered automatically on applying for admission.
amount: Full tuition offset, living allowance (~AUD 37,000 per year), relocation and thesis allowances

title: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Merit-based scholarship awarded automatically to the highest-achieving commencing international undergraduate students, applied as a percentage reduction of tuition fees for the duration of the course.
amount: 10%, 25%, 50% or 100% tuition fee reduction for the course duration

title: University of Sydney International Scholarship (USydIS)
description: Scholarship supporting international students undertaking a PhD or Master's by Research at the University of Sydney, covering tuition and providing a living allowance stipend.
amount: Full tuition and a living allowance stipend (~AUD 41,700 per year) for up to 3-3.5 years

title: Scientia PhD Scholarship Scheme
description: Flagship UNSW doctoral scholarship offering an enhanced stipend and a dedicated development and career support package, awarded through a targeted annual round aligned with nominated supervisory teams and projects.
amount: Stipend of ~AUD 43,000 per year for four years, tuition cover, and AUD 10,000 per year development support

title: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
description: Merit-based tuition scholarship for commencing international undergraduate and coursework postgraduate students at ANU, assessed automatically from the admission application.
amount: 25% to 50% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the course

title: Monash International Leadership Scholarship
description: Highly competitive scholarship for international students commencing an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at Monash who demonstrate outstanding academic achievement and leadership potential.
amount: 100% of tuition fees for the duration of the course

title: UQ Research Training Scholarship
description: Scholarship for domestic and international applicants of exceptional research potential undertaking a higher degree by research at UQ, covering tuition and providing a living stipend.
amount: Tuition cover and a living allowance (~AUD 37,000 per year) for up to 3.5 years
